title: Burst error model for Medium simulator
description:
Add temporally correlated packet loss to simulate real RF burst errors. Current LossRule is i.i.d. (each packet independent), but real RF has correlated failures (fade duration, interference bursts).

Options:
- Gilbert-Elliott two-state Markov model (good/bad states with transition probabilities)
- Sliding window correlation (loss probability increases after recent losses)
- Slow fading envelope (fading persists across packets to same destination)

Implementation: New ChaosRule or PropagationModel enhancement. Should be per-link (A→B can be in fade while A→C is clear).
